sentences.text:
Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No.623 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Ms. Sadaf, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Vipul Painiuly, Brief Holder for the State.
Applicants seek anticipatory bail in FIR No.0338 of 2024, under Sections 354, 328, 376(2)(n), 420 and 506 IPC, Police Station Gangnahar, District Haridwar.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
According to the FIR, the co-accused Parvez, who happens to be the cousin of the informant, raped the informant after administrating some intoxicating material.
He took some photographs and videos, and thereafter, blackmailed her.
He also prepared some forged documents, including nikahnama.
The applicant no.1 is the father of the co-accused, Parvez, and applicant no.2 is the brother of the co-accused, Parvez.

It is argued by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants have no role in the offence; the applicants have not done anything; the applicants are not witness in the nikahnama.
State to file objections.
List this matter on 22.08.2024.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail subject to their furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicants shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any other witness in the case.
(ii) They shall cooperate with the investigation.

ABA/623/2024 on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67423110/
1
(iii) They shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) They shall deposit their passports with the AO.
The passports may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case the applicants do not have passport, they shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicants shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.

(Ravindra Maithani J.) 12.07.2024 RV ABA/623/2024 on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67423110/
